title: Side sessions: the agent proposes, the person allows; a copy never made for a folder git ignores
request: The owner's goal: the same capabilities as Claude Code desktop; side sessions were the last medium gap.
plan: a start_session tool for the agent
a card that is the person's decision each time
a new session in its own copy

decisions.decision: the tool runs only after the person's Allow on a decision card, never 'always'
decisions.why: starting work in the person's project is the person's decision

change: dclab-code server/side_sessions.js (new), server/config.js and server/guards.js (the person rule and its reason), server/engine.js (the tool; a missing folder said plainly), server/app.js (startSideSession; copies refused for an untracked folder fall back to the folder itself, for side sessions and scheduled tasks), server/worktree.js (refuse before making such a copy), tests, docs.

findings.defect: a side session (or a scheduled task, or Own copy) in a project folder git ignores ran in a folder that did not exist
findings.scenario: live session s_f21c1552ee28: the copy of R&D did not contain agent_runs/live_tests/live-project; the SDK blamed its binary
findings.cause: a git worktree has only tracked files
findings.fix: refused before the copy is made; side sessions and scheduled tasks work in the folder itself and say so; a missing folder is said plainly
findings.test: server test with an ignored project folder; live rerun s_15bc5b2a81eb worked in the folder

findings.defect: the failed run left a full copy of the R&D repository
findings.cause: the copy was made before the folder was known missing
findings.fix: removed through DCLab Code's Remove; the check now runs before any copy

measurements.name: live
measurements.gate: the agent proposes, the card is the person's, Allow starts a working side session
measurements.result: two runs, $0.18; the second side session worked in the folder and asked before editing; denied, README unchanged

outcome: The agent can hand a piece of work to a new session with the person's Allow; no copy is ever made that lacks the project.
lessons: A copy of a repository holds only what git tracks: check the project is in it before making one.
Say the real cause: a tool's own error message can point at the wrong thing.
risks: a hand-off of the task under way is not built
